description: Ministry of Education - Degree Awarding Institute Order Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka (ICASL) Master of Public Finance Management
reasoning: This gazette notification involves the amendment of a schedule to an order under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It establishes regulatory conditions and requirements for a degree program (Master of Public Financial Management) offered by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka. The content primarily deals with legal/regulatory matters, specifically the modification of statutory instruments and the establishment of compliance frameworks for educational qualifications, which falls under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While a government minister is named, the core content is about regulatory conditions and legal authority rather than government personnel or structural changes.
